summary: In the workout builder (step 3), the 'Add exercise' button, which used to show a 'TODO' alert, now opens a modal listing exercises grouped by muscle (filtered by the chosen equipment, no stretches); clicking one adds it to the workout. Adds a read-only server action to fetch the exercise catalog, translations, and CSS fixes for modal backdrops.

statements.why: Only adds UI and a read-only catalog query (getExercisesByMuscleAction via actionClient, no login needed, but it only reads public exercise data). Nothing is saved, deleted or charged.

statements.text: • The agent changed how the app looks on small screens like phones (in src/shared/styles/globals.css).
statements.why: globals.css:73-86 add unconditional rules for every modal (full-viewport .modal-backdrop, scrollbar-gutter: auto while a modal is open) at all screen sizes; the 768px media query only repeats them. It's a modal-backdrop fix for the new exercise picker, not a phone-layout change, and it's the only thing the card describes.

statements.text: Type checking is turned off in 1 spot in workout-builder.store.ts (`any`).

misses.what: The card doesn't say what changed: the 'Add exercise' button in workout creation step 3 now opens an exercise picker (grouped by muscle, filtered by selected equipment) instead of a 'TODO' alert.
Exercise names in the picker show in French only for French users and English for everyone else (Spanish, Portuguese, Russian, Chinese users see English names).
